existing_pipeline_screen.scope: Targeted technical comparison with identified patent claims; not a complete patent landscape, legal opinion, or freedom-to-operate clearance. Official status, families, equivalents and licenses remain unverified.

components.finding: Historical SIFT patent reported expired-lifetime. Native code is original implementation; this does not clear unrelated later patents.

Fixed depth hypotheses scored per pixel; coarse depth interpolation supplies initialization. Does not select candidate mappings propagated from neighboring fine pixels followed by perturbation as in the reviewed correspondence claims. This is a technical distinction, not a non-infringement conclusion.

Neighboring-plane candidate propagation and perturbation are present. Material claim overlap concern; whether all limitations are met has not been legally determined. Excluded from ordinary builds and settings forms; explicit research-patchmatch feature retains the experiment without granting patent rights.

Depth estimates are rejected after matching by cross-view depth voting. No reprojection-error term in candidate ranking and no ACMM-specific coarse/fine photometric-difference detail restorer. Several general pipeline steps overlap; reviewed claim combination is not implemented as described.

Constant truncation width and silhouette-mask rim exclusion; no depth-edge-dependent shortening of the negative TSDF ramp. Limited comparison with this disclosed technique, not clearance of TSDF generally.
Historical marching-cubes record reported expired-lifetime. Does not clear unrelated newer meshing techniques.

Deterministic coordinate search on each own pixel plane; no neighboring plane candidates, propagation or random search. Regression test perturbs all other starting planes and verifies unchanged pixels remain bit-identical. Technical distinction only; no claim chart for all patents/families or legal clearance.
Interpolation falls back to nearest depth at gaps/jumps; fixed TSDF truncation width retained, no edge-dependent negative-ramp shortening. Technical distinction only, not TSDF patent clearance.

existing_pipeline_screen.decision: Keep default band pipeline; contain identified optional propagation experiment at build level. Continue measured improvements that avoid the identified propagation/perturbation and ACMM cost/detail-restoration combinations; never label the resulting pipeline patent-free.
